name: Dual Talent

choices.label: Dual Talent: the first ability score
Dual Talent: the second ability score

text: **Dual Talent**: Some humans are uniquely skilled at maximizing their natural gifts. These humans pick two ability scores and gain a +2 racial bonus in each of those scores. This racial trait replaces the +2 bonus to any one ability score, the bonus feat, and the skilled traits.
